name: Chimichurri Shrimp with Mashed Potatoes & Garlicky Sautéed Spinach

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium yellow potatoes
2 small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small bunch cilantro
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place herbs in a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add to the bowl with herbs along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a large bowl, along with half of the chimichurri, and stir to coat. (Reserve remaining chimichurri for serving.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add shrimp and cook until they are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer shrimp to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, then remove from heat. Cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are tender, drain in a clean colander and return to the pot. Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper, then mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) whole milk
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mashed potatoes between plates or bowls, then top with garlicky spinach and shrimp. Drizzle with reserved chimichurri and enjoy!
